content.short: Hardhat is a flexible and diverse Javascript-based framework for Ethereum blockchain developers.
content.description: Hardhat is a widely used Javascript-based development environment for building Ethereum-based decentralized applications. It streamlines smart contract development by automating routine tasks and offering a comprehensive set of features designed to boost productivity. The platform provides a pre-built local Ethereum network tailored for Solidity development, together with an extensive suite of plugins and built-in debugging tools that help developers test, debug, and deploy contracts more efficiently.
content.meta: Hardhat is a flexible and diverse Javascript-based framework for Ethereum blockchain. Discover Hardhat and other Web3 Developer Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.

resources.title: Managing Config Values and Secrets Safely
resources.tldr: Private keys in a committed config file remain a common way teams lose funds. Covers the mechanism Hardhat provides so they never sit in the repo.

resources.title: Deploying Smart Contracts Using Hardhat Ignition
resources.tldr: Declarative deployment: describe the end state and let the tool work out the ordering and resume from failures.

resources.title: Displaying Execution Traces
resources.tldr: Short, and disproportionately useful: seeing exactly which calls ran and what they returned is the fastest way to understand why a transaction reverted.
